capabilities.name: Widget

decision.rationale: Generated from the active legacy coverage matrix; refine product intent at the leaf.

capabilities.notes: Form fields. The largest non-visual use of annotations in the format — every AcroForm field's on-page presence is a Widget. Field VALUES are text, so this is a redaction carrier. Page-raster oracle APIs legitimately draw nothing here (pdfium's form-fill layer is a separate pass), which is why Widget rows are judged over 3 engines, not 5. Widget's real text carrier is field /V (see pdf.17.interactive.forms), not annotation-level extraction; its base /Contents is alt-text only and is scrubbed by RedactionCarriers.Annotations (#1427) regardless.

knownLimitations: Form fields. The largest non-visual use of annotations in the format — every AcroForm field's on-page presence is a Widget. Field VALUES are text, so this is a redaction carrier. Page-raster oracle APIs legitimately draw nothing here (pdfium's form-fill layer is a separate pass), which is why Widget rows are judged over 3 engines, not 5.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Link

decision.rationale: Generated from the active legacy coverage matrix; refine product intent at the leaf.

capabilities.notes: Navigation only: GoTo and URI. A /URI is user-visible text and travels with the file, so it is a carrier. §12.5.6.5 default 1pt border implemented in #987; the absurd-width case refuses per #1015. extract is partial via the generic /AP appearance-stream text path (TextExtractor.EmitMarkupAnnotationLetters, #1429) -- any drawn text in this subtype's own appearance stream is extracted, verified via the AnnotationAppearanceStream carrier test. Its /Contents popup-comment text (where the subtype has one) is deliberately NOT folded into page.Text (matches mutool, #660) but IS scrubbed regardless by RedactionCarriers.Annotations (#1427) -- extract=partial reflects the extraction surface, not a redaction gap.

capabilities.name: Popup

decision.rationale: Generated from the active legacy coverage matrix; refine product intent at the leaf.

capabilities.notes: Deliberately never drawn inline — it is the note window for its parent markup annotation, and its text belongs to that parent. Recognised precisely so it is NOT rendered onto the page. Popup has no independent content by spec (§12.5.6.14): a parented Popup's own /Contents (if any) is ignored by conforming readers and its /Parent's /Contents governs. No /AP of its own either. Its parent's carriers are scrubbed by RedactionCarriers.Annotations (#1427) regardless.

knownLimitations: Deliberately never drawn inline — it is the note window for its parent markup annotation, and its text belongs to that parent. Recognised precisely so it is NOT rendered onto the page.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.
